name: app-tareas-final
description: Monorepo App Tareas: backend API + frontend Laravel

scripts.setup: npm install && cd backend && composer install && cd ../frontend && composer install && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend,vite -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:frontend:vite"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
